sources.title: Challenger Gragas top guide by Bomba Guy💣💥📚

passive.name: Happy Hour
passive.text: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.

spells.name: Barrel Roll
spells.text: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed.

spells.name: Drunken Rage
spells.text: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

spells.name: Body Slam
spells.text: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

spells.name: Explosive Cask
spells.text: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

damage.value: Gragas deals AP burst damage when built as an assassin.

archetype.value: Gragas is a flexible pick with both damage and utility, though his full-AP mid style is high risk.

axis.value: Gragas should farm with W early, avoid excessive Q poke, and push once strong enough.

winCondition.value: Gragas uses his crowd control and Explosive Cask to engage, disengage, and remove a carry from a fight.

spikes.why: Gragas can usually start pushing to assert pressure.

spikes.at: More points in Q and more mana
spikes.why: Gragas can farm and poke with Q more freely.
Gragas can use Barrel Roll more often as its cooldown falls from 10 to 6 seconds.

bait.why: Gragas has high cooldowns early, so spending Q reduces his immediate damage threat.

mistakes.value: Gragas runs out of mana quickly if he spams Q for early poke.
